title: 12 Best Viewpoints in Chiang Mai
description: Discover Chiang Mai's top viewpoints for breathtaking panoramas, serene temple vistas, and lush mountain landscapes. From iconic Doi Suthep to hidden gems like Mon Jam, find your perfect scenic escape.

places.name: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Best Time to Visit: Early morning for sunrise views and to avoid crowds.

places.name: Mon Jam
places.priceRange: Free entry to viewpoint areas, cafe drinks 80-150 THB (~$2.20-4.15)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the local strawberries (seasonal) or a hot coffee from a hillside cafe while enjoying the expansive views.

places.name: Wat Phra That Doi Kham
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Best Time to Visit: Late afternoon for a spectacular sunset view over the cityscape.

places.name: The Giant Chiang Mai
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A hot latte or local brew while suspended in the canopy, soaking in the unique atmosphere.

places.name: Doi Pui Hmong Village Viewpoint
places.priceRange: Free to viewpoint, village entry might have small donation 20 THB (~$0.55)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try some local Hmong coffee or fresh fruit from the village stalls for an authentic taste.

places.name: Pha Chor (Chiang Mai's Grand Canyon)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Best Time to Visit: Morning or late afternoon to avoid the midday heat and harsh sun for better photos.

places.name: Kew Mae Pan Nature Trail (Doi Inthanon National Park)
places.priceRange: 300 THB (~$8.30) for National Park entry, plus guide fee 200 THB (~$5.50) per group
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Best Time to Visit: Early morning for mist and cool temperatures, especially from November to February.

places.name: Wat Phrathat Doi Saket
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Best Time to Visit: Afternoon for golden light over the fields, or any time for tranquility and cultural appreciation.

places.name: Doi Luang Chiang Dao Viewpoint (from cafes/resorts)
places.priceRange: Cafe drinks 80-150 THB (~$2.20-4.15) if visiting a specific spot.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A strong local coffee or a traditional Thai meal while gazing at the iconic mountain, often shrouded in mist.

places.name: Huay Tueng Thao Lake
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Fresh grilled fish (Pla Pao) and Som Tum (papaya salad) in a lakeside hut for an authentic Thai meal.

places.name: Chiang Mai Grand Canyon (Water Park)
places.priceRange: Entry 150-350 THB (~$4.15-9.70) depending on activities chosen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Best Time to Visit: Mid-day to enjoy the water activities and beat the heat.

places.name: The Observatory Coffee & Bistro (Mon Jam)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature iced coffee and a Thai fusion dish, like spicy pasta, accompanied by the stunning vista.
